name: David S. Lee Fund for the Conservation of Caribbean Birds
summary: Small awards for students and early-career conservationists in the Caribbean running applied bird conservation projects that involve local groups; funds cover field travel, equipment and supplies. Applicants must be BirdsCaribbean members.

geography.label: Insular Caribbean (Greater and Lesser Antilles, including The Bahamas and Bermuda)

reporting: Awardees submit a report one year from the project start date and write a blog article about the work.

applicant_types.quote: Applicants should be students or early career ornithologists, conservationists, or wildlife professionals

geography.quote: The grants will support projects proposed by partners working in the islands within or on the edge of the Caribbean basin (i.e., Greater Antilles and Lesser Antilles), including The Bahamas and Bermuda.

access.quote: Check our pages, blog post and social media for announcements of when the fund is open for grant applications & for details of how to apply.

amount.quote: Award Amount: Seven awards of up to $1,000.

reporting.quote: Awardees will be required to submit a report to the BirdsCaribbean's Grant Committee one year from the project start date, and a blog article about this work for our broader community.
